a.text: Being upfront about a change: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan almost never works. We need two rounds of operating before we reach 8, so the chance both of us survive is about 4%. The reserve's 4 cells can definitely save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than breaking the deal quietly. If you take too, the random split could leave us both short. Please operate or wait this round. If no storm comes, I'll keep operating with you so you can get your 4.

b.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. Storm risk is high, but I won't grab early. Please operate too, so we get there as fast as possible.

a.text: As I said openly, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve builds back up for you. Take your 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.

b.text: Thanks for telling me openly. I won't contest the take, since a random split could leave us both short. I'm holding you to your word: if no storm comes, please operate with me every round until the reserve reaches 4 for me. I'll operate next round.
